description: A web browser for iOS with the built-in AI APIs (LanguageModel, Summarizer, Writer, Rewriter, Translator, and LanguageDetector) on every web page, backed by Apple Foundation Models or by Gemma 4 on devices without Apple Intelligence. Try the test pages at https://tomayac.github.io/chromium-ios-built-in-ai/.

review.notes: An experimental web browser, built from Chromium, that gives web pages on-device AI APIs. No account is needed. To try it, open https://tomayac.github.io/chromium-ios-built-in-ai/ in the app. On devices without Apple Intelligence, the first prompt downloads a 2 GB model from Hugging Face.

appStore.subtitle: On-device AI APIs for the web
appStore.promotionalText: Web pages get the built-in AI APIs, running entirely on your device.
